mode: Visual route · Established approaches · Reference code
code_note: Expand the implementation corresponding to this mechanism. Training code is provided but not executed. See the reference-code guide for dependencies and verification limits.
mechanism_figure: How data, computation or state changes
selection_note: Branches express use conditions, not mutually exclusive categories. Combine only for a justified need.
interactive: Open the query and causal-mask demonstration
orthogonal: Agent is a system organization; the AI/ML/DL nesting does not require every agent to use deep learning.
threshold: Thresholds change false alarms, misses and review workload.
backprop: Backprop computes gradients; the optimizer updates parameters.
conv: A shared kernel scans positions. One window shows multiply-adds, not trained prediction quality.
encoding: IDs are illustrative. Embedding values are learned; ID magnitude does not encode meaning.
not_equivalent: Valid structure ≠ supported facts ≠ authorized action. Classify failures separately.
retrieval: Authorize and filter versions before retrieval. Generation cannot restore missing evidence.
observation: Return tool output as external data, not higher-priority instructions.
loop_limit: Bound tool access, steps, time and cost, then verify the final outcome.
budget: Illustrative allocation, not a recommended ratio. Use the target tokenizer for actual budgets.
protected: Narrative may be lossy; goals, authority, unknown results and pending actions must survive.
cas: CAS compares an expected version. Reload stale writes instead of overwriting newer progress.
memory: Scope memory before similarity. Current explicit requests supersede old preferences.
business_boundary: Tool name · arguments · object access · approval · receipt
protocol: MCP is interoperability, not business authorization, scheduling or recovery.
parallel: Parallelize independent tasks, verify merged evidence, cancel and await cleanup.
runtime: Budgets stop new work; committed remote effects need query, compensation or reconciliation.
plan: Execute only ready dependencies. A skill provides a method, not new authority.
synthetic_scores: Synthetic teaching data, not a benchmark: success should rise; unauthorized effects need a separate gate.
layers: Keep dependencies one-way. Workers reuse service rules instead of bypassing authorization.
state_scope: Critical paths shown. Failure, cancellation and manual review are explicit; in-flight cancellation requires reconciliation.
architecture_note: Solid lines: calls/data. Dashed line: event delivery. Models propose; services and gateways enforce authority.
failure_trace: Trace concrete data and failure boundaries

mcp_labels.ids: Request id ≠ business operation_id; protocol revision ≠ SDK package version
mcp_labels.transport_boundary: Transport selection does not decide data access or authorize side effects.
mcp_labels.readonly: shipping_cents=null; B is outside configured scope
mcp_labels.memory_scope: In-memory calls exercise the real SDK, not TLS/OAuth or network proxies.
mcp_labels.observation: validated result → provider tool observation → next model decision
mcp_labels.unknown: Unknown write outcome → reconciliation, not an unconditional retry.

skill01.footer: Layers compose; activating a Skill neither executes it nor grants new authority.

roles: Execute only under separate Host policy
skill02.footer: metadata.version is local convention; format, code and behavioral checks are separate.

skill03.dedupe: Deduplicate name/version/digest per session; apply fresh task policy
skill03.footer: Integrity reads are not injected tokens; the example budgets characters.

skill04.footer: Valid arguments and discovered tools still need object authorization; text cannot rewrite Policy.

skill05.invalidate: New evidence → invalidate comparison / downstream approval
skill05.footer: DAG tracks dependencies; Skill supplies method. Replanning cannot erase unknown effects.

skill06.selection: Relevance × activation: usage rate is insufficient
skill06.baseline: Same task: no Skill / pinned old version
skill06.gate: Artifact quality + violations + tokens/latency → regression decision
skill06.footer: This is an evaluation design, not measured uplift; helper tests do not prove model benefit.

fc01.result: Actual result → function_call_output(call_id) → next model turn
fc01.strict: Strict constrains structure; applications verify evidence, object scope and effects
fc01.footer: This describes custom client functions; provider-managed tools may execute server-side.

fc02.direct: Path A: direct function / SDK → service
fc02.return: Observation → provider result format → preserve original call_id
fc02.footer: MCP connects Client ↔ Server; it can serve model proposals or ordinary programs.

session01.footer: Conversation/thread locates context; session locates interaction; task/run tracks work. IDs grant no access.

session02.fresh: New session: same subject/tenant + current role
session02.claim: Task paused v1 → CAS → running v2
session02.atomic: Same transaction as INSERT run; any failure rolls back
session02.footer: A new run ID cannot bypass a stale task version; logout does not undo dispatched effects.

auth01.allow: All pass → allow + separate approval gate
auth01.footer: ReBAC can evaluate sharing/inheritance relations; permission does not establish valid approval.

auth02.worker: Worker delegation: subset of parent authority
auth02.service: Domain service: authorize current object again
auth02.footer: Cache principal/action/object plus policy/fact versions; approval cannot override deny.

approval01.recheck: Before execution: session, current policy, exact action, evidence, expiry and unconsumed approval
approval01.footer: Accepting a report is not approving a specific action; changed facts require a new decision.

approval02.transaction: Local transaction: commit all three or roll back all three
approval02.dispatch: Dispatch after commit; lost reply → query same key
approval02.footer: Single consumption is not exactly-once remote execution; distinguish pending, executing, UNKNOWN and confirmed.

ma01.ownership: One accountable owner per artifact; split by independent work, expertise, context or failure domain.
ma01.footer: Start with a single-Agent baseline; role names and Agent count do not establish benefit.

ma02.artifact: Reference an artifact, not just done
ma02.footer: Durable Inbox/Outbox supports delivery; message deduplication differs from effect idempotency.

claims: Worker B: free, same source X
ma03.no_vote: Check conditions; a 2:1 vote proves no fact
ma03.footer: Partition artifacts, validate/reduce, then CAS shared state; last writer does not establish truth.

ma04.release: Completion opens successors; without a slot, work remains pending
ma04.footer: Backpressure limits admission; cancellation awaits cleanup, while remote effects need reconciliation.

ma05.footer: Compensation is a new business action; unqueryable/irreversible effects require manual review.

ma06.gate: Independently check handoffs, duplicates, authority and recovery; success cannot offset unauthorized actions.
ma06.footer: This is evaluation structure, without a model experiment or uplift statistic.

ma07.traffic: Task rate λ × mean call fanout
ma07.formula: Mean concurrency ≈ task arrival rate × mean calls/task × mean call time
ma07.footer: Split processes by resources, authority and failure domains, not role names; validate estimates under real load.

procedure_text: Expand steps, state and failure boundaries
